entries.name: Cabi's Raw Chocolate
entries.description: Adds a 45% chance to release an <color=#844205>Earth Drill</color> when using basic arcana!

entries.name: Cabi's Citrus Sweets
entries.description: Adds a 45% chance to summon a <color=#ffff00ff>Lightning Strike</color> when using basic arcana!

entries.name: Cabi's Bubble Gum
entries.description: Adds a 45% chance to shoot a <color=#3c57e0>Bouncing Bubble</color> when using basic arcana!

entries.name: Gloves of Gambit
entries.description: Increases damage for all <color=#214051>Projectile arcana by 10%</color>!

entries.name: Magician's Top Hat
entries.description: Normal arcana have a 18% chance to cast as enhanced! Additionally, all arcana have a 18% chance on cast to lower their <color=#5f7dad>Cooldown by 50%</color>! Required for the [<color=#FFCC00>Magician's Outfit</color>].

entries.name: Vicious Bunny Ears
entries.description: Increases the base damage of all Jump arcana by 15%! Additionally, Each extra Jump arcana used within 1.5 Seconds gains another 10% Damage Bonus! This bonus does not cap, and you do not need to hit a enemy to keep it going.

entries.name: Flashy Windbreaker
entries.description: Prevents <color=#4d67a0>Slow</color> status effect!

entries.name: Starchy Parachute
entries.description: Reduces damage taken from <color=#749ecc>Air by 25%</color>.

entries.name: Ella's Glass Kite
entries.description: Ignore the next 5 Hits of damage. Then, the relic breaks.

entries.name: Cassim's Airy Cloak
entries.description: After taking damage, become invincible for 1 Second. 20 Second cooldown.

entries.name: Prismatic Vambrace
entries.description: When hit by elemental damage, increase your resistance to that element PERMENANTLY by 0.05%! Caps at 25% Resistance per element.

entries.name: Curse Eater's Vest
entries.description: Each cursed relic increases your <color=#9d8766>Armor by 1%</color> and <color=#f90233>Max Health by 5%</color>!

entries.name: Lonely Soul's Boots
entries.description: Dashing consecutively with perfect timing <color=#5f7dad>Lowers your Cooldowns</color> and lets you <color=#13a835>zip around faster</color>!

entries.name: Mobius Quill
entries.description: When you would cast your <color=#0060f0>Fully charged Signature</color>, Instead you <color=#5f7dad>Resets your Cooldowns</color>!

entries.name: Jumper Cables
entries.description: After clearing a locked room, for the next 5 Seconds gain <color=#13a835>35% Movement Speed</color> and <color=#5f7dad>75% Cooldown reduction</color>!

entries.name: Chaos Visor
entries.description: Gain the ability to forsee the trajectory of your arcana!

entries.name: Graduation Cap
entries.description: Increase chaos gem gain for all wizards! (Dropping a piggy bank at the end of a run gets you more crystals tho...) Required for the [<color=#FFCC00>Prestigious Diploma</color>].

entries.name: Curse Eater's Watch
entries.description: Each cursed relic lowers your <color=#5f7dad>Cooldowns by 4%</color>

entries.name: Token of Doom
entries.description: Tempts Nox the Unfortunate to emerge in the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Luck
entries.description: Entices Nocturne the Cardist to attend the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Health
entries.description: Pages Doctor Song to the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Elegance
entries.description: Books Savile the Tailor to visit the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Commerce
entries.description: Calls Cremire the Collector to case the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Wealth
entries.description: Plies Doki the Banker to appear in the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Token of Triumph
entries.description: Summons Taffy the Pinata to the Chaos Trials! Only one token can be held and in effect at a time.

entries.name: Catalystic Tonic
entries.description: Get a <color=#f90233>15% Chance</color> of receiving a <color=#f90233>Critical Heal</color>!

entries.name: Prestigious Diploma
entries.description: Doubles Gem drop rate. Doubles Relic drop rate. Increases <color=#c9a110>Gold Gain by 20%</color>. All effects apply to all wizards, but does not stack with similuar effects.

entries.name: Magician's Outfit
entries.description: Normal arcana have a 30% chance to cast as enhanced! Additionally, all arcana have a 30% chance on cast to lower their <color=#5f7dad>Cooldown by 50%</color>! Increases <color=#f93d09>ALL Damage by 20%</color>!

entries.name: Titan's Equilibrium
entries.description: Unenhanced arcana gain <color=#f93d09>20% Damage</color> and <color=#5f7dad>25% Cooldown Reduction</color>! Enhanced arcana LOSE <color=#f93d09>20% Damage</color> and <color=#5f7dad>25% Cooldown Reduction</color>!

entries.name: Anemic Marker
entries.description: Your signature arcana is permanently activated, but deals <color=#f93d09>20% Less Damage</color> and has a <color=#5f7dad>50% Longer Cooldown</color>, and gets EVEN LONGER by <color=#5f7dad>15% per Cast</color>!

entries.name: Graduation Bouquet
entries.description: All Wizards Gain <color=#c9a110>DOUBLE GOLD</color> but halfs your relic drop chance. Does not stack with similuar effects. Required for the [<color=#FFCC00>Prestigious Diploma</color>].

entries.name: Magician's Wand
entries.description: Increases <color=#f93d09>ALL Damage by 20%</color> but lowers the activation speed of all arcana by 30%! Required for the [<color=#FFCC00>Magician's Outfit</color>].

entries.name: Cruel Chess Clock
entries.description: Reduces <color=#5f7dad>Cooldown by 50%</color> but deal <color=#f93d09>30% Less Damage</color>!

entries.name: Unicorn Disguise
entries.description: Gain <color=#13a835>10% Movement Speed</color> and achieve max speed <color=#13a835>75% Faster</color>!

entries.name: Rules of Contingency
entries.description: Makes <color=#f93d09>ALL DAMAGE dealt and taken deal exactly 99 damage</color>!

entries.name: Makeshift Bridge
entries.description: Pits no longer appear in hallways, but you take <color=#f93d09>10% more Damage</color> from pitfalls! (They still appear in battle rooms).

entries.name: Aberrant Deck
entries.description: Shops have a <color=#c9a110>75% Discount</color>! However... Spells <color=#94DE40>BREAK</color> when their <color=#94DE40>Uses hit Zero</color>! <color=#94DE40>Broken Spells</color> are randomly replaced with a new ones! Basic Uses: 15. Dash Uses: 12. Spell Uses: 5. HUB only.

entries.name: Chaotic Comedy
entries.description: Turns on <color=#EF1414>INSTANT DEATH MODE</color> where all players and enemies are defeated in one punch! HUB Only.

entries.name: Conga Drum Set
entries.description: Spawns explosive barrels randomly throughout the trials! HUB only.

entries.name: Rulebook of Thieves
entries.description: All shops have a <color=#c9a110>75% OFF SALE</color>!. Enemies have a <color=#6CCE09>25% Chance to Steal</color> your spells or relics when hit!. HUB Only.

entries.name: Chaotic Pendulum
entries.description: All Wizards and Enemies have <color=#5f7dad>75% Lower Cooldowns</color>. Enemies gain <color=#13a835>25% Movement Speed</color>, Their Spells deal <color=#f93d09>25% More Damage</color> and are <color=#0060f0>Cast 25% Faster</color>! HUB Only.

entries.name: Quantum Capacitor
entries.description: You gain <color=#13a835>40%Movement Speed</color>. ALL Enemies gain <color=#13a835>50%Movement Speed</color> and their spells <color=#0060f0>Cast 25% Faster</color>! HUB Only.

entries.name: Melting Pot
entries.description: Gain 25% resistance to all the elements! Any enemy can appear on any stage. HUB Only.

entries.name: Broken Stress Ball
entries.description: Gain <color=#0060f0>Signature Charge</color> from attacking destructibles!
